payload.title: Close E011 uncertainty routing without E013
payload.decision: Reject H016 and do not preregister E013. Preserve E011 unchanged as deployment primary. Do not retune hard/soft fallback, blending, local weighting, or additional classifiers over the same legal E011/E006 uncertainty feature space.
payload.rationale: Oracle fallback/blend headroom is large, but legal identification fails across seven model families, 25 repeated cells, ten spatial/typewell holdouts, special slices, and shuffled controls. The best branch gains only 0.006868 RMSE, wins 2/5 maps and 5/25 cells, has near-random inner AUC, and regresses typewell group 0 and high-GR-missingness wells. Exact deterministic reproduction and ten edge groups pass.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only materially new sequence/state evidence that is not a reparameterization of the same 151 legal well-level features may reopen uncertainty-conditioned placement.
